entities.name: Query MsrA
observations: 169 aa protein with exact sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt Q6AG94.
Annotated as peptide methionine sulfoxide reductase A; Pfam PMSR domain PF01625 spans residues 3–153.
Sequence-derived molecular mass is 19,047.87 Da and theoretical pI is 5.14.

entities.name: Q6AG94 MsrA
observations: Reviewed Leifsonia xyli subsp. xyli peptide methionine sulfoxide reductase A, 169 aa, exact sequence match to query.
Catalyzes reversible reduction of protein-bound methionine sulfoxide to methionine; EC 1.8.4.11.
Reference active-site annotation is at position 11.

entities.name: MsrA thioredoxin reaction
observations: Curated Rhea-linked reaction: L-methionyl-[protein] + reduced thioredoxin system is represented as reversible oxidation-reduction involving methionine sulfoxide, methionine, water, and thioredoxin disulfide/dithiol forms.
Rhea mappings include RHEA:14217 and RHEA:19993; EC 1.8.4.11.

entities.name: Query MsrA sequence properties
observations: Length 169 aa; calculated molecular weight 19,047.87 Da; theoretical pI 5.143; calculated charge at pH 7 is approximately −8.03.
